To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the nanonized GBD in the biodegradable chitosan patch was able to improve the efficacy of the drug in reducing blood glucose levels, and counteracting the induced hyperglycaemia in the tested animals, with minimal side effects.
the nanonized glibenclamide was incorporated in a chitosan patch for transdermal delivery and the nanoscale formulation showed improved efficacy compared to the conventional micro-scale formulation.
GBD nanocrystal-loaded chitosan patches were developed for transdermal delivery.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and evaluation of a novel chitosan patch loaded with GBD nanocrystal for transdermal delivery.
engineering, formulation, and evaluation of a new TDDS for transdermal delivery of GBD, which is a well-established antidiabetic drug.
the development of a novel GBD TDDS based on nanocrystalline GBD.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
GBD nanocrystal-loaded chitosan TDDS was able to enhance drug delivery, efficacy, and safety of GBD.
GBD nanocrystal-loaded chitosan TDDS was successfully developed and characterized, and its in vitro and in vivo performances were superior to the conventional micro-GBD-loaded TDDS.
nanonization is an efficient technique for the development of transdermal delivery of poorly water-soluble drugs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
nanonized drug in chitosan patch could be a promising alternative for the treatment of type 2 diabetes.
the nanonization of GBD followed by incorporation in a biodegradable chitosan matrix is a successful approach for the development of TDDSs for GBD delivery with enhanced efficacy and safety profile.
the developed TDDSs are promising candidates for the treatment of diabetes mellitus and could be a promising alternative for GBD oral therapy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
GBD nanocrystal-based transdermal delivery system can be used as an effective alternative to oral therapy for type 2 diabetes.
the nanosizing of GBD in a chitosan-based patch is a promising strategy for the development of transdermal drug delivery systems.
the engineered nanocrystalline GBD can be formulated into a TDDS to achieve enhanced transdermal delivery and improved therapeutic effect compared to the conventional oral therapy.
